headline: STAY on X.1
why: No X.1 trade today: the bot session only started at 09:44 ET, after X.1's 09:35-09:40 entry window, so the day was skipped by rule (check why the Pi started late). Had it run, it would have shorted 25213.5 and been stopped at 09:58 (-1R, ~-$455) before the day reversed +1120 pts; still 3 live trades (-3.1R), far too few to judge, so no change.
